d: The Distribution Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing last mile delivery operations, ensuring the timely, efficient and cost-effective delivery of Marketplace and Xcite C&C products to customers. The role is accountable for managing delivery and administrative teams; driving operational excellence; improving customer experience and Net Promoter Scores (NPS); implementing technology-driven solutions; and achieving key operational, financial and service performance targets.
q: Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management or a related field, with a focus on last mile delivery.
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
r: li
Lead, coach & develop delivery teams and administrative staff to achieve operational excellence and high performance
li
Manage last mile delivery operations, including scheduling, routing, dispatching & resource planning
li
Establish, monitor and drive KPIs related to productivity, service quality, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
li
Coordinate with warehouses, showrooms, customer service teams and business stakeholders to ensure seamless order fulfillment and delivery execution.
li
Ensure delivery accuracy, service reliability and on-time performance to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
li
Monitor NPS and customer feedback, resolve escalations promptly and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
li
Oversee fleet operations, vehicle maintenance, and transportation resources while ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
li
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and technology solutions to enhance operational efficiency, productivity, and cost optimization.
li
Develop, implement, and continuously improve SOPs, operational controls and Health & Safety best practices across delivery operations.
li
Utilize data analytics and performance reporting to identify trends, support decision-making, and drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
